newsitem.title: USA: Main Street sees Q4 loss greater.
newsitem.headline: Main Street sees Q4 loss greater.

text.p: Main Street and Main Inc said on Tuesday that it expects to record a loss for the quarter exceeding the $507,000 loss reported for the third quarter.

The company said that sales declined and expenses increased in the fourth quarter. Main Street said it will evaluate the "realizability" of certain assets and may record an additional restructuring charge for the fourth quarter.
Main Street's primary lender agreed to modify certain provisions of the company's long-term debt, including a $125,000 reduction in quarterly principal payments.
In connection with obtaining the modified terms, the company raised $3.0 million in equity through the issuance of 1,520,000 shares of its common stock at market prices to various investors.
The company said it is exploring other modifications to, or the refinancing of, its debt.
Main Street said it intends to deleverage the company and improve its working capital position.
Main Street said it will continue to evaluate opportunities to further improve its financial condition and operating results.
